Is Aussie Instant Freeze a viable cruelty-free alternative to Got2B?
Hi everyone, I'm currently working on a cosplay of Mela (from *Pokémon Scarlet/Violet*):

![img](xoaac536eghd1)

(isn't she awesome?) and I need help on selecting styling products for the wig.

I know everyone swears by Got2B, but that company tests on animals and I refuse to endorse animal cruelty. I tried researching alternative products, but so far I have had no luck in finding consistent recommendations.

I was thinking of using the Aussie Instant Freeze Maximum Hold hairspray and sculpting hair gel, which is certified as cruelty-free by PETA. Would these products be a suitable alternative to Got2B? If not, then what would the recommended alternatives be?

Animal welfare is something that I really care about, so I will not compromise it for a cosplay.
